Edits made to /workspace/drafts/definition-format-research.md (all in place):

1. Header: added revision note recording the completeness-critique repair pass — dated 2026-08-06 (the pass ran the day after the 2026-08-05 draft; dating it "same date" would have been false, deviation from the instruction noted).
2. New §1.6 "Quality-management lineage" added after 1.5 (ISO 9001:2015 7.5 + N1286, ISO 9000:2015 vocabulary, ISO 10013:2021, Shewhart 1939, Deming wheel/PDCA, PDSA/Model for Improvement, CTQ tree, DMAIC), description-only; old 1.6/1.7 renumbered to 1.7/1.8 (no stale cross-references — only §1.2/§1.3 were ever referenced by number).
3. QM corrections applied per verification: ISO 10013 hierarchy pyramid re-attributed to ISO/TR 10013:2001 with the 2021 foreword quote; obsolete-document rule marked as 2008-explicit/2015-implied; CTQ definition given as paraphrase of the ASQ glossary, not quotation; DMAIC tollgate cited to practice literature, not the ASQ page; unverified "14 pp." dropped.
4. QM woven into section 2: 2.1 (CTQ as second derivation anchor beside 330xx, with leaf-admissibility and both coverage tests), 2.5(a) (CTQ leaf rule = Deming meta-rule; ISO 9000 verification-vs-validation naming the two check families), 2.6 (calibration loop named as a PDSA cycle), 2.7 (clause 7.5 as derivable audit rubric, maintain/retain mapping onto the 2.4 split, PDCA Act-as-standardization/DMAIC Control as the promotion-closure rule).
5. §1.2: added RACI/RAM (PMBOK glossary quotes, one-A rule with its doctrine-vs-glossary evidence status, unverified-origin note, failure modes), RASCI/RACI-VSL/CAIRO/RACIQ/PARIS variants, RAPID/DACI decision-rights fork (Intuit origin flagged unverified), Holacracy v5.0 role anatomy + Article 5 governance + Medium exit, Team Topologies interaction modes.
6. §2.2: RACI addressed explicitly — ADAPT with reasons (A column must reproduce RUP bindings as a consistency check; C/I is the genuine addition; operational definitions per letter; compile into frontmatter/primers against shelfware; RACI-VSL Verifier kept), with direct reference to bead lead-jozud.2 (confirmed to exist via bd show) and RAPID/DACI for the decision-rights portion; Holacracy Domains + amendment protocol folded in, Medium exit as over-codification caution.
7. §1.3: added DITA 1.3 topic typing (corrected: glossaryEntry is DITA 1.1; `<dita>` also a permitted root) and specialization architecture, Diátaxis (one-type rule flagged as paraphrase of the blur/collapse failure mode; colophon authorship caution), arc42 and docs-as-code in brief.
8. §2.3: stated that neither displaces 15289 — DITA specialization adopted as second anchor for deriving new kinds (ancestry declaration, generic fallback, constraint-vs-new-kind discriminator); Diátaxis quadrant declaration + one-type-per-document as lintable check; docs-as-code named as the enforcement substrate.
9. Repair 4 resolved via the Q1 option: open question 1 restated as "ratify 2.4's recommended BCP 14 discipline, or override with ISO shall/should"; 2.4 left as-is (consistent, since section 2 is explicitly undecided recommendations).
10. Evaluative leaks neutralized in section 1: CMMN ("addressed to case work whose activities cannot be fully pre-sequenced"), 24744 (uptake claim rephrased as survey observation with stated basis — also repair 6a), EPF ("implements the split in tooling"), AAC&U ("fully worked, operated artifact set"), ETVX (neutral description; the "only classic frame with validation in the cell" evaluation moved into 2.1 where it justifies adoption; CMMN's evaluation likewise moved into 2.1).
11. Repair 6b: TOGAF claim bounded to "among the sources this survey examined".
12. Repair 6c: verified live against platform.claude.com Skill-authoring docs (fetched 2026-08-06) — claim confirmed; 2.7 now quotes "There is not currently a built-in way to run these evaluations. Users can create their own evaluation system" with citation.
13. Repair 6d: Gherkin negative claim in 1.7 now states the grounding search scope (arXiv BDD×LLM×judge queries, Cucumber/SmartBear docs, surveyed eval-framework docs).
14. Repair 7: verified live at omg.org/spec/Essence — Essence 2.0 is still an in-process beta (beta 2 published March 2026, not formally published as of August 2026; 1.2 remains the current formal version); 1.1 corrected accordingly, marked "(corrected)".
15. Open questions 6 and 7 annotated with the CTQ table form and PDSA phase form respectively.

No findings dropped: all verified findings had exists=true; both accurately_described=false findings (ISO 10013, DITA typing) were integrated with corrections applied.

Repairs not completed: none. One constraint encountered: the session's WebSearch budget was already exhausted (200/200), but both required web verifications (repairs 6c and 7) completed via direct WebFetch of omg.org/spec/Essence and the Anthropic best-practices doc, so nothing was blocked.
result.recheck:
1. RESOLVED. New §1.6 covers the full lineage with citations: ISO 9001:2015 §7.5 (with ISO/TC 176 cross-verification noted), ISO 9000:2015 vocabulary, ISO 10013:2021, the Shewhart→Deming→PDCA/PDSA history (Moen paper, Imai, Ishikawa, primary Deming quotes), and Six Sigma CTQ tree + DMAIC. Recommendations carry it through, not just the survey: 2.1 (CTQ as second derivation anchor), 2.5(a) (CTQ leaf-admissibility; ISO 9000 verification/validation split), 2.6 (calibration loop framed as PDSA), 2.7 (ISO 9001 §7.5 mapped onto governance; PDCA Act-as-standardization as the closure rule), plus open questions 6–7.

2. RESOLVED. §1.2 now surveys RAM/RACI (PMBOK 6th ed., Cleland & King 1968 ancestry), the variant letter-sets (RASCI, RACI-VSL, CAIRO, RACIQ, PARIS), RAPID (Rogers & Blenko 2006) and DACI (Atlassian), documented failure modes, and Holacracy (Constitution v5.0 §§ cited, Robertson 2015, Medium's 2016 exit). §2.2 gives explicit treatment: RACI adapted as assignment overlay (not container), A-column derived from the existing one-responsible-role rule, RACI-VSL Verifier carried, RAPID/DACI for decision rights on bead lead-jozud.2, Holacracy Domains + amendment protocol folded into the role container, Medium as the over-codification caution.

3. RESOLVED. §1.3 now surveys DITA 1.3 (typing, maps, specialization/@class/constraint modules, with two marked corrections) and Diátaxis (two-axis derivation, four types, named failure mode, honest sourcing notes). §2.3 states impact explicitly: neither displaces 15289; DITA specialization adapted as the derivation/ancestry anchor for new kinds, constraint-module-style tightening as the cheaper governance action; Diátaxis quadrant declared per kind-schema, one-type-per-document as a lintable check; DITA XML machinery and the four Diátaxis types explicitly not adopted.

4. RESOLVED. Open Question 1 is rewritten as "ratify 2.4's recommended BCP 14 ALL-CAPS keyword discipline, or override it with ISO shall/should" — 2.4 is now framed as the standing recommendation and OQ1 as the ratify/override decision, consistent with the document's decides-nothing status header. No contradiction remains.

5. RESOLVED (one minor residue). (a) 24744: "essentially academic" replaced with a scoped observation explicitly marked "(observation from this research pass, not a cited measurement)". (b) TOGAF: uniqueness claim now scoped "among the sources this survey examined" — though "broadly adopted" itself still carries no citation or epistemic marker (residue; weaker fix than the 24744 treatment). (c) Anthropic runner: now a direct quote from the Skill authoring best-practices doc, cited and dated confirmed 2026-08-06. (d) Judged-Gherkin negative: §1.7 grounds it in an enumerated search scope (arXiv queries, Cucumber/SmartBear docs, each surveyed eval framework); §3's restatement leans on that grounding via cross-reference, acceptable.

6. RESOLVED (one borderline residue). CMMN's "clearest vocabulary" moved out of §1.1 into recommendation 2.1 where evaluation is licensed; EPF "working proof" replaced with descriptive tooling facts; AAC&U "mature exemplar" replaced with "fully worked, operated artifact set" (defensible as factual). Residue: ETVX (§1.1, line 60) now reads "the lightest classic per-activity frame" — the flagged superlative was replaced with another comparative superlative in the describe-only section rather than removed; the evaluative preference is properly restated in 2.1, so the §1.1 "lightest" is redundant as well as evaluative.

7. RESOLVED. Now reads: "Essence 2.0 is still an in-process beta, its beta 2 published March 2026 and not yet formally published as of August 2026, per the OMG specification page — corrected," consistent with the document date and the 2026-08-06 revision note.

New defects introduced by the edits (all minor):
- §1.1 line 60: "lightest classic per-activity frame" — replacement superlative in the describe-only survey (see verdict 6).
- §1.4 line ~272: "broadly adopted" remains uncited within the otherwise-scoped TOGAF claim (see verdict 5b).
- §1.2 line ~138: "stated as hard doctrine throughout PMI-affiliated practitioner literature" — a breadth claim identified only by source class, no specific citation.
- §1.2 line ~169: Holacracy gerund phrasing attributed to "documented HolacracyOne convention" without naming the document.
- §1.6 line ~474: "no single primary inventor source exists for the tree itself" — a new negative existence claim; hedged inside the citation parenthetical but without the explicit search-scope grounding §1.7's negative claim received.
- §1.6 line ~491: tollgate form "standard in the Six Sigma practice literature rather than on the cited ASQ page" — honest hedge, but the breadth assertion rests on one named handbook.

No new describe/recommend conflations beyond the ETVX superlative noted above; all substantive evaluative and adoption language added by the repair (2.1 CMMN vocabulary preference, 2.2 RACI/Holacracy treatment, 2.3 DITA/Diátaxis deltas, 2.7 ISO 9001 mapping) sits in section 2 where it belongs.
